title: Timer
text: Configure counter reset source of processor watchdog module, 1 input; {Watchdog counter reset source} and {Sample time} sets the frequency at which processor resets Watchdog timer. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Watchdog counter reset source
params.values: Watchdog counter reset source Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which processor resets Watchdog timer –1 (default) | scalar
